text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
“—Hello there! I love sports, and shining 
sweat connects the world!”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Your thrilling athletic UmaTuber, Sonon 
Elfie, here!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"This video is another U.A.F. special 
feature! Uncovering the 'now' of our 
finals contenders—Athlete Future!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"The athlete Umamusume we're interviewing 
today is right here! Thank you for joining 
us!"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Heeey, nice to meet you~. Though 
seriously, I was surprised you'd want an 
interview literally right after the match, 
hahaha."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"That was my first time watching an MMA 
match so close up, and it was so 
thrilling! What a spectacular victory!!"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I guess it was right after I did a 
similar interview before? There were a few 
changes in my personal life—"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: “—Is this the message board?!”

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Yep. People who've known me since back 
when I was running in the local circuits 
went out of their way to send it to me~"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Man... look at this. Things like 'I'm 
still cheering for you' or 'I've been 
searching for you all along'..."

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone came out to watch my match again 
today, and...——"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm grateful to the U.A.F. for bringing 
these people and me together. That's 
exactly why I plan on aiming for victory."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds great~~!! Let's have a real clash 
of sparks!"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
“—As expected of Elfie. You've got some 
serious talent for parkour too!”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"I am truly honored! I absolutely love 
jumping and leaping around!"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"‘Wouldn't it be cool to team up with me 
and aim for the top in parkour? Just 
kidding—’"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"......You know, I'm glad I took part in 
the U.A.F."

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, someone called out to me 
during practice. They said, 'I've been 
cheering for you since your racing days.'"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I retired due to injury... 
someone actually remembered me, huh~"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"It was only because I competed in the 
U.A.F. that people found me again. I want 
to live up to their expectations—"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"And with that, I'm taking the 
championship! Consider this a declaration 
of war!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"I accept your challenge with a bang! 
Let's make that sweat glisten at its 
finest!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In Sonon Elfie's recent videos, content 
delving into the current status of the 
finalists leading up to the finals 
continues to be posted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What differs slightly from the previous 
introduction... is that it puts a 
spotlight on the "changes" the athletes 
underwent through the U.A.F.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"The U.A.F. is a stage that carves out new 
possibilities for entertainment, and—"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"And once again, it should be a place 
where the drama of athletes and those who 
support them intertwines and connects—"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I came to realize it. ...And that I 
can do it, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I felt that the significance of 
'U.A.F.' discovered by Ryoka Tsurugi was 
becoming something truly tangible—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was an attachment in the email 
titled "Invitation to Tour the U.A.F. 
Finals Venue"—
